title: Replace raw work identifiers in remaining agent error envelopes
outcome: Replace raw work identifiers in remaining agent error envelopes
acceptance: The agent error projection exposes documented work references, using typed variant-specific shaping, for exactly these StoreError variants at the declared source: WorkNotFound, WorkRevisionConflict, WorkNotOpen, WorkPeerDecompositionRefused, WorkPrerequisiteAlreadySatisfied, WorkDetachRefused, WorkClaimMismatch, WorkClaimLapsed, WorkReleaseWaiverRequired, WorkCompletionRefused, WorkBoundVerificationRefused, WorkCompletionRecoveryRequired, AcceptanceCriteriaRequired, AcceptanceEvaluationRefused, AcceptanceEvaluationAdmissionRefused, AcceptanceEvaluationCarriedFailure, AcceptanceEvaluationBasisMoved, OpenWorkObligations, WorkReferenceAmbiguous. CLI text, CLI JSON and MCP agree, while the raw host/core envelope, stable refusal codes and scoped evidence, seal and evaluation identifiers remain unchanged. WorkReferenceAmbiguous must retain an unambiguous, admitted candidate command and the documented full-work-ID fallback when a short reference collides; caller-supplied reference text is not rewritten. Existing WorkClaimHeld projection remains covered as a regression.

completion.summary: The 18 listed refusals name their work item by short reference on agent surfaces (CLI text, JSON/MCP message, work_ref in place of work_id where details carry it, and a reminder repeating the message); caller-supplied text is never rewritten; an ambiguous reference lists full-id candidates; the core envelope keeps raw ids. Landed in 99c249e (bundle 8C-1).
